channel.description: A daily 8-10 minute audio briefing on world finance and geopolitics.

item.title: Briefing: September 14, 2026
item.description:
Good morning. It's Monday, September the 14th, and here's your world briefing on finance and geopolitics — everything you need before you get to the office.
Let's start with the security story dominating the morning. Overnight, a Russian drone struck a Ukrainian train near the Polish border, just after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and a group of senior European officials had left the very same station.
